Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, you can take her entire follow-up combo, so move behind minions. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can also hit on its return; after dodging the first pass, keep moving out of its return path.
Ahri.build: Dodging Ahri E Charm takes priority over building resistance. Build magic resistance against Ahri's main damage, but it will not reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Ahri.fight: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and use the movement speed to stay in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while fighting. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to trade.
Ahri.laning: Keep minions between you and Ahri to avoid Ahri E Charm, and manage mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If the enemy jungler's location is unknown, do not push the whole wave with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast; keep the lane in the middle.
Ahri.combo: For basic poke, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Ahri rushes straight at you, follow Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. When Ahri comes in with Ahri R Spirit Rush, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under her to stop her movement.
Ahri.escape: Right after Ahri E Charm is used is your chance to fight up close. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and pressure her with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while she cannot dash away. When Ahri comes straight at you, look to stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Ahri.phase: Your sustained damage becomes strong from mid game onward once you have invested points in E and bought a mana item. Late game, deal steady damage from a position where you cannot be caught.
Ahri.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. After dodging Ahri E Charm, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under Ahri if she comes in, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she rushes straight at you.

Akali.watch: If the mark lands, the second dash follows Cassiopeia as she flees.
Akali.build: Against Akali, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between your core items, to buy time to survive her engage. Build magic resistance and health against her main damage. Because Akali has relatively high magic resistance, also consider magic penetration when increasing your damage.
Akali.fight: After landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the movement speed to keep your distance while repeating Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, do not walk forward to trade. When Akali leaves her shroud and rushes at you, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under her to prevent her from dashing or escaping.
Akali.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and manage mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Do not push forward if the enemy jungler's location is unknown. While Akali's ultimate is down, dodge Akali E Shuriken Flip, then build a health and CS lead.
Akali.combo: The basic sequence is to apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Akali rushes straight at you, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, land Q, then use E repeatedly. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma under Akali after she engages to prevent her escape.
Akali.escape: Before Akali R Perfect Execution is available again, Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is especially good for countering a head-on engage. If she has used only one mobility tool, she can escape with the other, so do not chase hastily.
Akali.phase: In mid game, your E investment and mana item give you strong sustained damage, so look for openings while Akali's ultimate is down. Late game, Cassiopeia has strong teamfight damage as long as she is not caught, so fight behind your frontline.
Akali.teamfight: Do not engage first. From behind your frontline, keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on targets poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. If Akali dives into your backline, place Cassiopeia W Miasma on her approach or under her. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when enemies, including Akali, rush at you head-on.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range as it hits enemies, so do not stand in line with minions, and dodge both its outward and return paths. If Akshan swings in along a wall with Akshan E Heroic Swing, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under him to stop his movement. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you while your health is low, move behind terrain instead of fleeing alone into the open.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical and Cassiopeia has low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.fight: Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Akshan is about to walk, then use the movement speed to keep your distance while repeating Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, do not walk forward to trade. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used is your chance to close the distance.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang can extend its range by hitting minions, so avoid standing in line with them and stay out of angles where he can poke with basic attacks. If the enemy jungler's location is unknown, do not push the lane forward, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Akshan.combo: If Akshan comes straight at you, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang repeatedly. If using R is difficult, land Q first and repeat E while the poison lasts. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma where Akshan lands after coming in with Akshan E Heroic Swing to stop his movement.
Akshan.escape: Close the distance right after forcing Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing.
Akshan.phase: Your sustained damage becomes strong from mid game onward once you have put points into E and bought a mana item. Late game, deal damage from a position where you cannot be caught. If you have the Scoundrel mark, do not face Akshan alone.
Akshan.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Akshan enters your backline with Akshan E Heroic Swing, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under him; use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he rushes straight at you. If you have the Scoundrel mark, fight outside Akshan's finishing range.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate mid-flight and stun you, so stand outside its range from the start instead of merely stepping a little off its path. Being hit by Q or standing in a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm increases the damage from Anivia E Frostbite. If you are hit, leave the storm instead of continuing to fight. In narrow passages, Anivia W Crystallize can block your retreat.
Anivia.build: Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost or the crowd control from Anivia W Crystallize would lead to a decisive hit, use Quicksilver Sash to remove it.
Anivia.fight: After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Anivia is about to walk, then use the movement speed to stay in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while trading. If Q misses, do not walk forward to trade. When Anivia P Rebirth has already been used, look for a kill with your team.
Anivia.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then manage mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If the enemy jungler's location is unknown, do not push the lane, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma in case of a gank.
Anivia.combo: When Anivia closes the distance while facing Cassiopeia, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on the poisoned Anivia. Using R while Anivia turns her back to flee will only slow her, so wait for a head-on angle that can stun.
Anivia.escape: If Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down and you land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, the movement speed gives you a chance to close the distance. Anivia has no mobility ability, but Cassiopeia also has no ability to escape on her own, so do not force your way in while Anivia still has crowd control available.
Anivia.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage becomes strong in mid game with a mana item and points invested in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Late game, watch for Anivia's terrain control and deal sustained damage from a position where you cannot be caught.
Anivia.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes into your backline, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies rush at you head-on. Fight in wide lanes rather than narrow passages where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your retreat.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of its range. If you dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep, the second hit will not come out, so dodge the first attack. Ambessa R Public Execution can pass over an ally in front of you and target the farthest champion in a line, so do not stand in line with Ambessa.
Ambessa.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. If the enemy team has an assassin, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between core items.
Ambessa.fight: Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then trade while staying in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Counterattack right after Ambessa uses her abilities and her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges. Do not attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation.
Ambessa.laning: Keep the wave in the middle instead of pushing the entire wave with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and do not push forward when you cannot see the enemy jungler. Place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Ambessa will step up to last-hit, and trade with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang only when she is poisoned.
Ambessa.combo: If Ambessa engages head-on, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you have already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast in her path, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she faces you while standing in the poison. When you see the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its range.
Ambessa.escape: The moment after Ambessa uses all her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges is your chance to engage. Ambessa R Public Execution is unstoppable, so do not try to interrupt its cast with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she builds core items, but Cassiopeia also gains strength once she has a mana item and sustained damage from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. In the late game, stay where you cannot be caught and keep dealing damage.
Ambessa.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma in Ambessa's path into your backline or where she lands. Reposition so you are not at the end of the line of Ambessa R Public Execution, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze on enemies charging at you head-on.

Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, so stay out of her ability range. Annie R Summon: Tibbers deals area damage, and the summoned Tibbers keeps burning nearby enemies, so keep your distance even after killing Annie.
Annie.build: If the stun from Annie P Pyromania holds you in place long enough to take all her magic damage, consider Quicksilver Sash first. Build magic resistance against Annie's damage, but account for the magic penetration on Annie R Summon: Tibbers rather than relying on resistance alone.
Annie.fight: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to start a trade.
Annie.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle. Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. Keep your distance when Annie's stun is ready, and do not push forward when you cannot see the enemy jungler.
Annie.combo: When Annie approaches while facing Cassiopeia, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Annie.escape: The window after Annie uses the stun from Annie P Pyromania and before it is ready again is your chance to close the distance. Annie has no ability to create distance on her own, so land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and follow her, then look for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Annie faces Cassiopeia.
Annie.phase: Your sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game onward, once you have put skill points into Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and bought a mana item. In the late game, keep your distance so you do not get caught, and deal sustained damage in teamfights.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or her stun is ready, do not stand on top of allies and get caught together by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze to stop enemies engaging head-on.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, and taking it for too long causes extra damage and builds Stardust for him. Stand behind minions and leave its line of fire quickly. When low on health, avoid even the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity because of its execute threat; if caught, walk out immediately. After Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered, spread out from allies to avoid its area knockup.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If you are caught by the crowd control from Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and then take follow-up damage, consider Quicksilver Sash to remove it. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building large amounts of health alone.
AurelionSol.fight: Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then trade while staying in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to trade. If Aurelion Sol comes in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath him and counter with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment he faces you.
AurelionSol.laning: Stand behind minions so you do not take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light for too long and give him Stardust. Place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where he is about to walk. If you cannot see the enemy jungler, do not push forward, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol approaches while facing you, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you have already poisoned him with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze to stun him when he charges through it, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze will not stun him if he is running away with his back turned.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you force Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your chance to close the distance. While Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is unavailable, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and follow him; if he faces you, catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend can still catch you, manage your distance first.
AurelionSol.phase: After that, look for windows when Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is unavailable and pressure him before he builds up Stardust.
AurelionSol.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Aurelion Sol enters your backline with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath him and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment he charges at you head-on. Spread out from allies so several of you are not hit by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend together.

Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the path of its returning damage. That damage increases as your health gets lower, so retreat instead of staying in range while cursed. Leaving Aurora R Between Worlds slows you, so create distance before the area appears.
Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Aurora's damage. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building large amounts of health alone. Get movement speed to help you leave telegraphed areas.
Aurora.fight: Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Aurora is moving, then use the movement speed it grants to stay in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while trading. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to trade with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Aurora dashes in, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath her and look for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment she faces Cassiopeia.
Aurora.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Watch Aurora's position and place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where she will step up to last-hit; follow with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang only if it lands. If you cannot see the enemy jungler, do not push forward, and save Cassiopeia W Miasma in case of an engage.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora engages head-on, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath her to stop her movement, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and repeated casts of Cassiopeia E Twin Fang in that order. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast lands first, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment Aurora charges at Cassiopeia while facing her, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. While Aurora is stealthed with Aurora W Across the Veil, do not rush Cassiopeia E Twin Fang; place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where she is likely to appear.
Aurora.escape: After Aurora has used both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding, you have a chance to catch her. Especially if Aurora R Between Worlds has not come back yet, block her path with Cassiopeia W Miasma and look for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she faces you. If only one mobility ability is unavailable, she can escape with the other, so do not rush the chase.
Aurora.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game onward, once you have put skill points into Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and bought a mana item. In the late game, keep your distance so you do not get caught, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on targets poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast.
Aurora.teamfight: From behind her frontline, Cassiopeia repeatedly casts Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on targets poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma in Aurora's path into your backline or beneath her when she lands, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies engage head-on. Aurora can jump again if she participates in a kill, so do not leave a low-health ally behind when retreating.

Azir.watch: Do not linger in the attack range of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! After Azir moves a soldier with Azir Q Conquering Sands, check its new position and dodge. In narrow passages, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push several teammates back together, so do not crowd in from the front.
Azir.build: Get a mana item first so you can deal sustained damage in the mid game. Azir deals magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor.
Azir.fight: When a soldier is stationary and Azir Q Conquering Sands is on cooldown, move out of the soldier's attack path and target Azir himself. Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then stay in range and use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to trade.
Azir.laning: Early on, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage mana. Do not force your way in while Azir's soldiers remain active; look for windows when they disappear or Azir is low on mana. Do not push the wave forward when you cannot see the enemy jungler.
Azir.combo: If Azir comes in head-on, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If he enters an area where you have already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while the poison lasts.
Azir.escape: The moment after you force Azir E Shifting Sands is a chance to close the gap. If Azir places a soldier near a wall, he can escape toward it, so place Cassiopeia W Miasma on that path to block his movement. Once Azir R Emperor's Divide is on cooldown, you can close in without the risk of being pushed back.
Azir.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage grows strong from the mid game once she has a mana item, but Azir also grows stronger as the game goes on, so take chances to kill him. Late game, deal sustained damage from a position where Cassiopeia cannot be caught.
Azir.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma on Azir's path into your backline or where he has already entered, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment he charges in head-on. Keep Azir R Emperor's Divide in mind and do not crowd into narrow passages with your team.

Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him. Corki R Missile Barrage can hit the area around a minion even when you stand behind it, so move out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid taking the third missile in succession.
Corki.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical and Cassiopeia has low armor, so build armor first. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.fight: Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Corki is about to walk, then use the movement speed to stay in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, do not walk forward to trade. Once Corki W Valkyrie is on cooldown, look for a window while he has no mobility to escape.
Corki.laning: Corki is also weak for the first five levels, so pressure him when you can land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and deny him easy farm. If you cannot see the enemy jungler, do not push the wave forward, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Corki.combo: When Corki W Valkyrie is on cooldown and Corki is facing you, follow up Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place the poison where your ultimate stuns him, then repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while the poison lasts. If you use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze on Corki as he runs away with his back to you, it will only slow him, not stun him.
Corki.escape: The moment after you force Corki W Valkyrie is a window to close the gap. Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, follow him with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, and catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze if he faces you.
Corki.phase: Put your skill points into Cassiopeia E Twin Fang in the mid game; once you have a mana item, your sustained damage grows strong. Late game, Corki can also fire missiles from a safe position once he has items, so it is important to disrupt his farming from the early game.
Corki.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment enemies charge at you head-on.

Ekko.watch: When the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence appears, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Step away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and watch for the follow-up attack when he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If you can see Ekko's afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not overcommit to a chase even if he is low on health.
Ekko.build: Prioritize tenacity over magic resistance to avoid being locked down by the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence and hit by his follow-up. Consider Quicksilver Sash if you need to remove the stun, and build magic resistance instead of armor. If the enemy team has an assassin, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between core items.
Ekko.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and manage mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Aim Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Ekko will step up to last-hit or along his path, and trade with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang only if it lands. If you cannot see the enemy jungler, do not push the lane, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma in case of a gank.
Ekko.combo: If Ekko comes in head-on, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. You can also use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Ekko charges into an area where you have already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. Keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while he is poisoned.
Ekko.escape: Start a fight after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are on cooldown. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown, do not chase; he can still escape with his ultimate. Before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up, look to land Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze while he faces you, just after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive.
Ekko.phase: From the mid game, once you have invested skill points in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and bought a mana item, use its sustained damage. Late game, deal damage from a position where you cannot be caught, and look to fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is on cooldown.
Ekko.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma on Ekko's path into your backline or under him when he enters with Ekko E Phase Dive. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Ekko charges in head-on, and keep track of his afterimage's position if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in an arc, so sidestep it. If it hits and marks you, create distance because it can reset the cooldown of Diana E Lunar Rush. Do not fight at close range right after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade, and keep space between yourself and teammates so Diana R Moonfall does not pull in several of you.
Diana.build: If the enemy team has an assassin, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between core items. Build magic resistance over armor against Diana's damage, and value movement speed to leave the telegraphed attack area.
Diana.fight: For a standard trade, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to stay in range for Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana enters first with Diana E Lunar Rush without using Diana Q Crescent Strike, catch her with Cassiopeia W Miasma or Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Diana.laning: Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage mana.
Diana.combo: When poking, use Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Diana comes in head-on, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Diana.escape: If you’re hit by Diana Q Crescent Strike, Diana E Lunar Rush may become available again, so don’t try to catch her; create distance. The window to counterattack is right after Diana uses E Lunar Rush without Q Crescent Strike. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma then, or Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Diana is facing you.
Diana.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage grows strong from the mid game once she has put skill points into Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and bought a mana item. Late game, deal damage from a position where she cannot be caught.
Diana.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use vision to prevent Diana from entering from the flank, and keep space between yourself and teammates so Diana R Moonfall does not pull you in together. If Diana enters your backline, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under her feet, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment she charges in head-on.

Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike is a dash, and Fizz E Playful / Trickster provides both a slow and mobility, so don’t move forward just because one of them is down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters’ fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.build: Fizz’s main damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Bring Zhonya’s Hourglass forward in your build, between core items, so you can withstand Fizz’s combo.
Fizz.fight: Fight while keeping Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range with the bonus movement speed after landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade. Counterattack as soon as Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown, while holding Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Fizz.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage mana. Look for a trade when Fizz misses a last hit with the empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident and its cooldown starts. Don’t push the lane forward when you can’t see the enemy jungler, and don’t waste Cassiopeia W Miasma on poke.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and Fizz comes straight at you, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze. Then apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Fizz.escape: If only Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down, don’t go in deep, since Fizz can escape with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. The chance to catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and counterattack comes right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown.
Fizz.phase: Cassiopeia’s damage over time gets stronger from mid game, once you’ve put points into E and have a mana item. In the late game, apply poison from a position where you can’t be caught and deal damage over time with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Fizz.teamfight: From behind your frontline, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma on Fizz’s approach or beneath him after he dives in. When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, focus him with your allies; if he charges straight at you, counter with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze. Don’t chase Fizz alone, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets.

Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s root or forced movement, you’re likely to get hit by the follow-up as well. If the first ability hits, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so walk out of its telegraphed area.
Hwei.build: The source doesn’t specify a particular item to buy first. Build magic resistance against Hwei’s magic damage, and also consider movement speed to get out of range and tenacity against the crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.fight: Look for an opening right after Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave. Land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then keep your distance and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to try to trade.
Hwei.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage mana. Place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Hwei is going to walk or step forward to last-hit, and don’t push the lane forward when you can’t see the enemy jungler. Before taking a path where Hwei has left an eye, send minions ahead to trigger it or take another route.
Hwei.combo: Your basic trade is to apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Hwei comes in facing Cassiopeia, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then cast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and follow up with repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you cast Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze on Hwei while he’s facing away, it only slows him instead of stunning him.
Hwei.escape: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to close the distance. Hwei has no mobility spell, so land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and use the movement speed to catch up, but don’t engage first while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available.
Hwei.phase: Damage over time gets stronger from mid game, once you’ve put points into E and have a mana item. In late-game teamfights, keep dealing damage from a position where you can’t be caught.
Hwei.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on paths leading into your backline or beneath enemies who have dived in, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge straight at you. Take a wide route around corridors covered by Hwei’s placed abilities.

Galio.watch: Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see the backward windup, and stand near a wall to shorten its dash distance. When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, don’t unload your damage; walk out of taunt range. Avoid the point where both gusts overlap from Galio Q Winds of War, and immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Galio.build: Get mana items so you can deal sustained damage in the mid game. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Galio’s damage, and prioritize tenacity if crowd control is getting you killed. If Galio builds magic resistance, magic penetration is more valuable than adding more ability power.
Galio.fight: After dodging Galio E Justice Punch, hit Galio with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range as you trade. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
Galio.combo: Your basic poke is to hit the spot where Galio is walking with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then follow with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Galio charges straight at you and you can stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Galio charges over it.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is on cooldown. Look for a window after dodging the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio E Justice Punch is on cooldown, while Galio R Hero’s Entrance is still unavailable. Then hit him with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and follow up; if Galio is facing you, catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Galio.phase: Once you have mana items in the mid game, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang’s sustained damage becomes strong, so dodge Galio’s engage before trading. In the late game, Cassiopeia has strong teamfight damage as long as she isn’t caught, so fight behind your frontline.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero’s Entrance is ready, don’t start a skirmish against Galio’s team in another lane. Leave the area when you see the landing marker. From behind your frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Galio dives the backline, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under your feet, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he charges straight at you.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia. Back off when a minion is about to die, and watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Cassiopeia has low armor, so build armor first. Hold on early with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Irelia.fight: After hitting with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the movement speed to keep your distance and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. If Irelia engages with Q Bladesurge, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under your feet to stop her movement.
Irelia.laning: Keep the wave in the middle and manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Create distance if a half-health minion that Irelia can dash to appears between you.
Irelia.combo: If Irelia charges straight at you, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. You can also use R when Irelia enters an area where you already placed Q. R only slows enemies who have their backs turned, so aim for her when she faces you.
Irelia.escape: The moment Irelia Q Bladesurge goes on cooldown is your chance to close the distance and fight. Catch her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then follow with Q Noxious Blast and E Twin Fang. Look for an engage again after Irelia E Flawless Duet is on cooldown.
Irelia.phase: Cassiopeia invests her abilities in E Twin Fang, and her sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once she has mana items. In the late game, deal damage from a position where you can’t be caught.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia from behind your frontline. Poison her with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then keep using E Twin Fang. If Irelia dives the backline, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under your feet. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Irelia or other enemies charge straight at you.

Karma.watch: Dodge Karma Q Inner Flame and the empowered Q from Karma R Mantra. If you’re hit by the burning zone, leave its area before it detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create enough distance to break the tether before you’re rooted. Don’t unload your damage while Karma E Inspire’s shield is active.
Karma.build: Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Movement speed is also important for escaping her zone and breaking the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve. No specific items are provided, so a purchase order can’t be determined.
Karma.fight: Hit the spot where Karma is walking with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range as you trade. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. The window to close the distance is after Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown and Karma E Inspire’s shield has expired.
Karma.laning: Early on, keep your distance and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to restore mana. Reposition so Karma can’t hit you for free with Karma Q Inner Flame and reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown. If you can’t see the enemy jungler’s position, keep the wave in the middle instead of pushing the whole wave with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast.
Karma.combo: Your basic trade is Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang; keep casting E while the poison lasts. If Karma faces you and engages, follow Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Q → repeated E. R only slows Karma if she has her back turned, so wait for an angle where she faces you.
Karma.escape: Close the distance after Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown and Karma E Inspire’s shield has expired. If W connects, first move far enough away to break the tether and avoid the root. Follow Karma only after hitting her with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed.
Karma.phase: Invest in E, and your sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once you have mana items. In the late game, keep your distance so you can’t be caught while dealing damage.
Karma.teamfight: From behind your frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available, since engaging first can get you caught. If Karma E Inspire is empowered by Karma R Mantra and shields nearby allies, attack after the shield expires. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when enemies charge straight at you.

Katarina.build: Bring Zhonya’s Hourglass forward among your core items to prepare for the enemy assassin Katarina. Prioritize magic resistance against her damage, and get health as well.
Katarina.fight: After hitting with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the increased movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range as you trade damage. If Katarina engages with E Shunpo, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under your feet to stop her movement, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she charges from the front.
Katarina.laning: Early on, keep the wave in the middle and manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Don’t push the lane aggressively with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and avoid the spot where the dagger from Katarina Q Bouncing Blade lands.
Katarina.combo: When Katarina engages from the front, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, stun Katarina with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she enters its area, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Katarina.escape: The moment Katarina uses E Shunpo on a target other than a dagger is your chance to pressure her. Block the spot so she can’t pick up the remaining dagger, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze on Katarina while she’s facing you to limit her chance to escape.
Katarina.phase: Invest in E, and your sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once you have mana items. In the late game, deal damage from a position where you can’t be caught, and don’t give Katarina the first kill and allow her to keep diving in.
Katarina.teamfight: From behind your frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Cast Cassiopeia W Miasma in Katarina’s path or under her feet, and save Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze to interrupt Katarina R Death Lotus. Have your team avoid the dagger locations and protect low-health allies to prevent Katarina from getting the first kill.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin can enter or escape with Kassadin R Riftwalk, so don't stand alone within his range. Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic poke, so attack after he uses it. Watch out for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse, and avoid using unnecessary abilities when he's nearby.
Kassadin.build: Since you're facing the assassin Kassadin, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your build, between core items. To mitigate Kassadin's damage, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Kassadin.fight: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don't walk forward to trade. If Kassadin enters with Kassadin R Riftwalk, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath you, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he's facing you.
Kassadin.laning: Spamming abilities near Kassadin reduces the cooldown of Kassadin E Force Pulse, so use only the abilities you need.
Kassadin.combo: For a basic trade, use Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Kassadin comes in from the front, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then cast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Cast Cassiopeia W Miasma where Kassadin entered with Kassadin R Riftwalk to prevent his next move.
Kassadin.escape: The window after Kassadin R Riftwalk is used is your chance to attack. If Kassadin E Force Pulse's slow and Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield are also down, hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and pressure him with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Kassadin.phase: Cassiopeia's damage over time gets strong in the mid game, so apply poison and fight when Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. In the late game, Kassadin can dive the back line where Cassiopeia is and escape, so don't stand alone. Deal Cassiopeia's damage over time from a position where you can't be caught.
Kassadin.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Kassadin dives the back line with Kassadin R Riftwalk, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath you. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Kassadin and the other enemies charge from the front.

Leblanc.watch: When LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, her next ability deals more damage, so don't move forward; back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, get beyond the chain's range before it roots you. Watch for LeBlanc W Distortion coming in from the front, and cast Cassiopeia W Miasma where she lands to stop her movement.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Since you're facing an assassin, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your build, between core items, to buy time when you're caught. A spell shield is also effective against combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice.
Leblanc.fight: Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to keep your distance while repeatedly using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don't walk forward to trade damage. Once LeBlanc W Distortion's return has been used or its duration expires, counterattack with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when LeBlanc comes in facing you.
Leblanc.laning: In the early game, keep the wave in the middle and manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Keep your distance while LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice's mark remains, and don't push the lane forward if you can't see the enemy jungler. Tell your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid lane vision.
Leblanc.combo: For a basic trade, use Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, then repeat E while the poison lasts. You can stop LeBlanc's movement by casting Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath her where she entered with LeBlanc W Distortion. If you stun her from the front with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, follow up with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Leblanc.escape: The chance to close the distance comes after LeBlanc W Distortion has been used and its return has been spent, or its return window has expired. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is down, you can follow up more easily without worrying about its root after hitting Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. If LeBlanc charges from the front, counter with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Leblanc.phase: Your damage over time gets strong from mid game, when you invest skill points in E and have mana items. In the late game, keep your distance so LeBlanc can't catch you, and deal heavy damage in team fights.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces through minions and continues behind the minion it hits, so don't stand in a line with minions. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots you or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns you, Cassiopeia has no mobility ability to avoid the follow-up damage. When Lissandra E Glacial Path flies out, watch where she can recast to and manage your distance.
Lissandra.build: Being caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is deadly, so prioritize Quicksilver Sash to remove crowd control. Lissandra's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance afterward.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast first to gain movement speed, then keep your distance and repeatedly use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don't walk forward to trade.
Lissandra.laning: Farm at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard's piercing projectile. Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Don't push the wave forward when you can't see the enemy jungler, and save Cassiopeia W Miasma in case they engage.
Lissandra.escape: The chance to close the distance comes right after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and follow up with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. While Lissandra E Glacial Path is flying, Cassiopeia W Miasma can prevent her from recasting it.
Lissandra.phase: Your damage over time gets strong from mid game, when you have mana items and have invested skill points in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. In the late game, Cassiopeia has high team-fight damage as long as she isn't caught, so keep your distance and build up damage.
Lissandra.teamfight: From behind your frontline, Cassiopeia applies poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keeps using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Lissandra comes toward Cassiopeia, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath you, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she charges from the front. Adjust your distance based on whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is available.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it's hard to dodge her follow-up abilities, so bait out Q and move after it misses. Q roots the first two enemies it hits, so don't stand in a line with your allies. If you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark, dodge to the side. Right after you're hit by an ability, don't stay within attack range while marked by Lux P Illumination.
Lux.build: Get a mana item first to support your damage over time in the mid game. Build magic resistance against Lux's damage, and get tenacity in case Lux Q Light Binding catches you.
Lux.fight: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, aim Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Lux will walk. Use the movement speed from landing Q to follow her while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Q misses, don't walk forward to try to trade damage.
Lux.laning: Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you can't see the enemy jungler, don't push the wave forward, and save enough mana to use Cassiopeia W Miasma against a gank.
Lux.combo: During the window after Lux Q Light Binding misses, trade with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you stun Lux with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze while she's facing Cassiopeia, apply poison with Q and keep using E. If you use R on Lux while she's turned away and running, it will only slow her.
Lux.escape: The chance to close the distance comes right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no ability to create distance, so hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then follow up. If Lux is facing Cassiopeia, you can stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Lux.phase: Cassiopeia's damage over time gets strong from mid game, when you invest skill points in E and have mana items. In the late game, you can deal heavy team-fight damage as long as you aren't caught, so position carefully and watch for Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Don't approach clustered with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can't trap you all together. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on paths into the back line, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies charge from the front.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to the nearest enemy, so don’t wait beside that minion to last-hit. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between the two portals to avoid the silence. Don’t walk through areas without vision alone, so Malzahar R Nether Grasp can’t catch you by yourself.
Malzahar.build: Get a mana item for sustained damage in the mid game, and prioritize magic resistance against Malzahar’s main damage. If you need to remove the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp yourself, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. Then hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, keep your distance, and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you haven’t poisoned him, don’t walk forward to start a trade.
Malzahar.laning: If Malzahar E Malefic Visions is on the wave, move away from the minions to avoid the effect transferring to you. Manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, but don’t push recklessly when the jungler’s position is unknown. Call your jungler when Malzahar has pushed the wave, then pressure him together after breaking Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.combo: Break Malzahar P Void Shift first with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. When Malzahar is facing you, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Even in a short trade, poison him first, then use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Malzahar.escape: Your opening comes after you dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and break Malzahar P Void Shift. Look for a moment when the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared or haven’t spawned yet. If Malzahar can use Malzahar R Nether Grasp, don’t close the distance alone.
Malzahar.phase: Still, use pressure and help from your jungler to limit the time Malzahar has to build stacks for Malzahar W Void Swarm. In the mid game, Cassiopeia’s sustained damage gets strong with a mana item; in the late game, you can deal teamfight damage as long as you aren’t caught.
Malzahar.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them first with area damage. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes leading into your backline. Save Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze for enemies approaching head-on.

Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if its center hits, and Mel Q Radiant Volley may follow, so dodge it sideways. If Mel P Searing Brilliance has built up enough Overwhelm stacks, it can execute you even while you still have health, so track how many times you’ve been hit and back away. If Overwhelm remains after you leave the fight, watch for Mel R Golden Eclipse, which has no range limit.
Mel.build: Get a mana item first so you can keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Mel’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance over armor.
Mel.fight: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare to the side, then trade after Mel W Rebuttal is down. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then attack while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
Mel.laning: Harass Mel by placing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where she’ll walk to last-hit. Pressure her to slow her growth, but don’t push the wave forward while the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Mel.escape: You have an opening to close the distance when Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast first to gain movement speed and chase her; catch her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she faces you.
Mel.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes leading into your backline or under enemies who engage. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies charge at you head-on.

Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, create distance until it ends so you can dodge the second Q. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang after W ends. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit dashes to a targeted champion, so don’t walk alone in front of Naafiri while her R is ready.
Naafiri.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so prioritize armor and get health as well. Since Naafiri is an assassin, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between your core items.
Naafiri.fight: Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then trade while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to fight. If Naafiri dashes in, place Cassiopeia W Miasma under her feet to block her mobility, then stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she faces you.
Naafiri.laning: Farm behind your minion line while watching for Naafiri to approach. Keep the lane as close to the middle as possible, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to restore mana. Since Naafiri can revive her pack with E Eviscerate, the moment right after Naafiri E Eviscerate is your chance to clear the pack and counterattack.
Naafiri.combo: If Naafiri engages head-on, follow with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang casts. If Naafiri charges into an area where you’ve already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on the poisoned Naafiri.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri has used either Q Darkin Daggers or E Eviscerate. Look for an opening before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back up, and approach after her other mobility spells are down and you’ve hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. When Naafiri faces you, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and block her escape route with Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Naafiri.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage gets strong in the mid game, but Naafiri’s roams are also at their most dangerous, so maintain broad vision and don’t get caught alone. In the late game, group with your team and start a front-to-front teamfight; area damage will clear Naafiri’s pack and reduce her damage.
Naafiri.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes leading into your backline or where Naafiri has entered, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies charge at you head-on. Immediately retreat right after an ally dies, since Naafiri can use R Hounds' Pursuit again.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs gets larger and faster if it hits something first, so don’t stand overlapping with an ally. If Neeko approaches while transformed, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden, so spread out in advance as soon as someone you suspect is Neeko closes in. Don’t attack or chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance against Neeko’s main damage. If you’ll die after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows, prioritize Quicksilver Sash to remove the crowd control. Cassiopeia loses as much time to attack as she spends rooted, so the goal here is simply to break free.
Neeko.fight: Try to trade right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then attack while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
Neeko.laning: Manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, and keep the lane in the middle if you have no reason to push. When the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t spend enough mana to push the entire wave with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and leave yourself without mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Neeko.combo: Your standard trade is to apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Neeko engages head-on, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then follow with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang casts.
Neeko.escape: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down, Cassiopeia has an opening to close the distance. If Neeko fights back head-on, counter with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Neeko.phase: Invest in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang; your sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game, once you have a mana item. In the late game, keep your distance and deal damage without getting caught by Neeko’s crowd control.
Neeko.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes leading into your backline or where Neeko has entered. Spread out in advance against Neeko’s transformed engage, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies charge at you head-on.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal helps her engage with a root or stealth, depending on the element. If she approaches with the river element, move outside the root’s range. If she disappears with the brush element, move into your allies’ vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent stuns when its shockwave hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid the river and narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Against the assassin, bring Zhonya’s Hourglass forward in your build, between core items.
Qiyana.fight: Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Qiyana is walking, then use the movement speed to manage your distance while repeatedly casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade. If Qiyana engages with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under your feet so she can’t escape with a mobility skill.
Qiyana.laning: Don’t force the wave forward. Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. When the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t push the lane forward, and save Cassiopeia W Miasma to respond to an engage.
Qiyana.combo: If Qiyana charges straight at you, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then cast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. You can also cast Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Qiyana enters an area where you’ve already placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze only slows Qiyana if she is running away with her back turned, so use it against a frontal engage.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, but Cassiopeia’s sustained damage also becomes strong from mid game onward, once you’ve put points into E and have mana items. Don’t give up an advantage in the early and mid game; build armor, then stay with your team and keep your distance in the late game.
Qiyana.teamfight: From behind your team’s frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Cast Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes Qiyana could use to reach your backline or under her feet after she engages. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she charges straight at you. Move grouped with your team, but stand away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can’t catch you.

Orianna.watch: Avoid the area around the ball after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves it, since Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and consecutive basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup. In particular, don’t accept basic-attack trades early.
Orianna.build: The source does not specify a particular first item to buy. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Orianna’s damage. Movement speed is also important because you need to walk out of the telegraphed attack around the ball.
Orianna.laning: Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. If the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t push the lane forward, and don’t waste Cassiopeia W Miasma on poke.
Orianna.combo: Your basic poke is Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. When Orianna faces you and moves in, follow Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze only slows Orianna instead of stunning her when her back is turned, so check your angle.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no skill to create distance on her own, so when you hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and gain movement speed, you have a chance to close the gap. She is easier to chase after the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the forced movement from Orianna R Command: Shockwave are used. Don’t enter the area around the ball.
Orianna.phase: Your sustained damage becomes strong from mid game onward, once you’ve put points into Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and have mana items. In the late game, deal damage from a position where you can’t be caught, while keeping track of the ball’s position.
Orianna.teamfight: From behind your team’s frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Avoid the area around Orianna’s ball, and cast Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes enemies could use to reach your backline. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge at you from the front.

Ryze.watch: When Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If you’re hit by the mark, move away from your allies and keep your distance until it disappears.
Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the root from Ryze W Rune Prison is a concern after you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, consider a way to remove crowd control.
Ryze.fight: Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Ryze is walking, then use the movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range as you trade. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to fight. Look for a chance to stun Ryze with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he approaches from the front.
Ryze.laning: While Ryze lacks mana and damage early on, pressure him from a position where you can hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. If the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t push the wave forward, and save enough mana to cast Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Ryze.combo: Your basic trade is to apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you can stun Ryze from the front, follow Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Ryze.escape: If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, so you can hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and close the gap. If Ryze is casting Ryze R Realm Warp, look for a chance to cancel it by stunning him from the front with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Ryze.phase: Before his items come online, pressure Ryze’s growth by landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast while his mana and damage are low. Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong from mid game onward, once she has mana items. In the late game, fight from a position where you can’t be caught.
Ryze.teamfight: From behind your team’s frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, move away from your allies to avoid Ryze Q Overload bouncing to nearby targets. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on routes to your backline, and cast Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when enemies engage from the front.

Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chains thrown after the first dash are more dangerous than the dash itself. If a chain hits you, Sylas pulls you in and knocks you up, so don’t move forward in response to his first dash; dodge the chains. Sylas Q Chain Lash’s intersection explodes after a delay, so move away immediately even if the first chain only clips you.
Sylas.build: Cassiopeia can deal sustained damage once she has mana items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Sylas’s damage. If the enemy team has an assassin, bring Zhonya’s Hourglass forward in your build, between core items.
Sylas.fight: After dodging the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to maintain your distance while repeatedly casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. Sylas can restore health with Sylas W Kingslayer, so don’t delay finishing him for too long after lowering his health.
Sylas.laning: Poke Sylas by placing Q where he will step to last-hit. If the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t push the wave forward; keep it in the middle and save mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma to respond to Sylas’s engage.
Sylas.combo: If Sylas engages from the front, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then cast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you placed the Q poison first, you can also cast R when Sylas charges into it. When Sylas has his back turned, R only slows him, so look for the moment he faces you.
Sylas.escape: The window to go on the offensive is after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is used and before it comes back up. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a way for him to move, so don’t chase recklessly just because E is down. If Sylas has already engaged, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under his feet to prevent him from moving further or disengaging.
Sylas.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong from mid game onward, once she has mana items. In the late game, deal damage from a position where you can’t be caught.
Sylas.teamfight: From behind your team’s frontline, Cassiopeia applies poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keeps casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma under his feet. When he faces you, pin him down with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze and attack before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Sylas can steal your ultimate with Sylas R Hijack, so keep your distance and don’t give him its range.

Talon.watch: Talon W Rake is dangerous if both the outbound and returning blades hit, since each hit stacks Talon P Blade's End. If the first hit lands, move out of the returning blade’s path. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, watch for an escape or counterattack using stealth, and don’t chase recklessly.
Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to build armor. Talon deals physical damage, so prioritize armor over magic resistance, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Bring Zhonya’s Hourglass forward among your core items so you can survive if Talon catches you. Talon tends to have high magic resistance, so consider magic penetration when adding damage.
Talon.fight: After Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits, use the increased movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range during trades. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. If Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy to engage, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma at your feet, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he charges straight at you.
Talon.laning: Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage mana. Keep the wave centered when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown. When Talon roams, share his position and secure vision along the jungle route.
Talon.combo: Start a basic trade with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, then repeat E while poison lasts. If Talon engages head-on and is stunned by Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, follow with R → Q → repeated E. If Talon engages with Q Noxian Diplomacy, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma at your feet to prevent him from escaping with a movement ability.
Talon.phase: In the mid game, you can fight with mana items and the sustained damage from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. In the late game, Talon’s influence falls off while Cassiopeia’s teamfight damage grows, so keep fights going from a position where he can’t catch you.
Talon.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Talon reaches your backline, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma at his feet or along his approach. Fight grouped with your team, and stun Talon with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he charges straight at you.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will deals true damage, and Syndra R Unleashed Power can execute you at low health, so watch your health. Move away from areas with several spheres, where you’re at greater risk of being hit by Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early to gain the movement speed needed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main damage, and also get health to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute threshold of Syndra R Unleashed Power. If a decisive hit starts with the long stun from Syndra E Scatter the Weak, use Quicksilver Sash to remove it.
Syndra.fight: While Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available, stay out of the spheres’ line and keep your distance. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is on cooldown, hit her with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then follow while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
Syndra.laning: Early on, keep the wave centered and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to restore mana. If you spend mana pushing the entire wave with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, you may not have Cassiopeia W Miasma when you need it, so avoid pushing, especially when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown. Precast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Syndra will walk to last-hit and apply poison.
Syndra.combo: Start basic trades with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. When Syndra E Scatter the Weak is on cooldown and Syndra is facing you, follow with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → repeated Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Apply poison while she is stunned by Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang for as long as the poison lasts.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool, so the moment it goes on cooldown is your chance to close the distance. Syndra has no movement ability, so use the movement speed from hitting her with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to get close, then stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze from the front.
Syndra.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game, when you can focus your abilities on Cassiopeia E Twin Fang and have mana items. In the late game, Cassiopeia has high teamfight damage as long as she isn’t caught. When you see the effects of Syndra’s empowered abilities, adjust your distance for their increased power and range.
Syndra.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma along the route enemies take to reach your backline or at the feet of enemies who have already entered. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge straight at you, and avoid areas covered with many Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has selected a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: If the enemy composition can land a decisive hit after the long stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, consider Quicksilver Sash first. To resist Twisted Fate’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
TwistedFate.fight: When the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is used, hit him with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and use the movement speed to fight while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, stay behind minions to dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards and basic-attack poke, and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Don’t push when the jungler’s position is unknown, and save enough mana to use Cassiopeia W Miasma against a gank.
TwistedFate.combo: If Twisted Fate engages head-on, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then cast Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeat Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you applied poison first with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the movement speed to keep your distance while continuing to use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from W Pick a Card is your chance to close in.
TwistedFate.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game, when you can focus your abilities on E and have mana items. In the late game, keep dealing damage from a position where you can’t be caught.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma along the route into your backline, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze against enemies charging straight at you. If you see Twisted Fate casting R Destiny and he is in range, interrupt it with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move and attack from within. Watch the ground marker for Veigar W Dark Matter and dodge to the side. If your health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Veigar.build: If Veigar E Event Horizon’s stun leads into a decisive hit, consider Quicksilver Sash first. Veigar Q Baleful Strike, W Dark Matter, and R Primordial Burst all deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building resistance.
Veigar.fight: Hit the spot where Veigar will walk with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then use the movement speed to keep your distance while landing Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. When Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown, you have a chance to close the distance.
Veigar.laning: After that, pressure Veigar’s early farming by casting Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast along the path he will take to last-hit. Use minions for cover to avoid unnecessary hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike, and don’t push the wave forward when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Veigar.combo: A basic trade is Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast → E Twin Fang. If you can catch Veigar from the front, follow with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Q Noxious Blast → repeated E Twin Fang. When you use R, make sure Veigar isn’t facing away, or it will only slow him instead of stunning him.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to engage is after Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown. Hit him first with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then chase. If you’re trapped by E, don’t cross the edge; move and attack from within, then close the distance once it disappears.
Veigar.phase: Veigar is also weakest early, before he has stacks, so pressure his farming afterward with Q poke and E last-hits. Cassiopeia’s sustained damage grows from the mid game, but Veigar’s stacks grow permanently too, so be more careful of his combo as the game goes on.
