Veigar.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep using E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma along the route into your backline, and use R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge straight at you. Before fighting for an objective, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used E Event Horizon.

Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has Doom active, her basic abilities can fear you, so don't move forward until the mark disappears. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so if you're already in range, sidestep briefly. If you're hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, she will dash in shortly, so move toward your allies immediately.
Vex.build: Get a mana item first so you can deal sustained damage in the mid game. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Vex's damage. Also consider movement speed to walk out of telegraphed areas and tenacity to defend against fear.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom and Vex W Personal Space are on cooldown. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to gain movement speed, then fight while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don't walk forward to try to trade.
Vex.laning: Early on, keep the wave centered and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. Don't spend mana using Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to clear the entire wave, and don't push forward when you can't see the enemy jungler. Harass by placing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Vex will walk to last-hit.
Vex.combo: When Vex comes straight at you, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast first, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Vex dives onto it. Against a Vex running away with her back turned, Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze can only slow her, so line up a front-facing angle.
Vex.escape: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom has been used and Vex W Personal Space is also on cooldown, hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast to close in. From a front-facing angle, hold Vex in place by stunning her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Vex.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game, once you've invested in E and bought a mana item. In the late game, deal damage from a position where you can't be caught, while watching for Vex R Shadow Surge to engage.
Vex.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. If Vex dives in with Vex R Shadow Surge, cast Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath her at the spot where she lands, then use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when she charges straight at you. Low-health allies should get out of Vex's range first so she can't get the first takedown with Vex R Shadow Surge.

Viktor.watch: To dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, don't stand in line with the minion wave; sidestep. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you only if you remain inside its area, so leave as soon as it's placed and don't keep trading inside it. Viktor R Arcane Storm also deals area damage, so walk out of its telegraphed area.
Viktor.build: Get movement speed first so you can escape Viktor W Gravity Field, and build magic resistance against Viktor's magic damage. If the enemy composition's decisive engage starts with the stun from Viktor W Gravity Field, use Quicksilver Sash to remove it.
Viktor.fight: Hit Viktor with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where he will walk, then use the movement speed to fight while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Q misses, don't walk forward to start a trade. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area first.
Viktor.laning: Stand clear of Viktor E Hextech Ray's wave-clear angle, and don't push the lane forward if you can't see the enemy jungler. Before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up, pressure him with Qs you can land.
Viktor.combo: If Viktor is facing Cassiopeia, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. When harassing without your ultimate, land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast first, then use Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Viktor has his back turned, Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze only slows him, so don't start a combo assuming you'll stun him.
Viktor.escape: Close the distance after Viktor W Gravity Field is on cooldown or once you've left its area. Viktor has no dash to create distance himself, so you can chase him with the movement speed from hitting Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze the moment Viktor faces you.
Viktor.phase: Look for chances to pressure Viktor before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up, but reassess the same trades once he has stacks. Cassiopeia's sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game with a mana item, and her teamfight damage is high in the late game, but Viktor also grows stronger over time.
Viktor.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang on poisoned targets. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on paths leading into your backline, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge at you from the front. Don't keep attacking inside Viktor W Gravity Field; leave immediately.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when Xerath takes a charging stance, change direction and sidestep. If you're stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you're vulnerable to the magic damage that follows, so watch especially for that shot. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begin its cast animation.
Xerath.build: If the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb could lead to a decisive hit, consider Quicksilver Sash first. Xerath deals magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building defenses.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are on cooldown. Hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Xerath will walk, then use the movement speed to fight while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don't walk forward to try to trade.
Xerath.laning: Early on, keep the wave centered and last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you even behind minions, so sidestep when he takes a charging stance. Farm while avoiding Xerath's heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when his mana runs low.
Xerath.combo: Apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you can close in on Xerath and land Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze from the front, follow up in the order R → Q → E. If Xerath has his back turned, Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze won't stun him.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are on cooldown is your chance to go in. Xerath also slows down while charging Xerath Q Arcanopulse, so sidestep it as you close the distance. If Xerath is casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, you can also engage where he can't move to.
Xerath.teamfight: From behind your frontline, Cassiopeia applies poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and keeps casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on paths leading into your backline or beneath enemies who have already engaged. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when multiple enemies charge at you from the front.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and grants movement speed, and it can become empowered, so don't recklessly close the distance before his empowered Q. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can dodge Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, so don't use R before the pool ends.
Vladimir.build: Vladimir's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Liandry's Torment is effective against Vladimir, who builds health. If the fight drags on and lets him heal, build defenses first, then add healing reduction.
Vladimir.fight: Hit Vladimir with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where he will walk, then use the movement speed to fight while staying within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range. If Q misses, don't walk forward to trade. Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends and Vladimir faces you, hold him in place with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze.
Vladimir.laning: Normally, last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana, and don't push the lane forward if you can't see the enemy jungler. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you.
Vladimir.combo: Apply poison first with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. After forcing Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, wait for it to end and for Vladimir to face you, then follow up with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze → Q Noxious Blast → repeated E Twin Fang casts.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to close the distance. Vladimir also slows down while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so if you can hit Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, gain movement speed and chase him. Don't force an engage after being hit by the slow from Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Vladimir.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage becomes strong from the mid game, once you've invested in E and bought a mana item. In the late game, use your early lead to keep Vladimir from scaling, and keep dealing damage in teamfights from a position where you can't be caught.
Vladimir.teamfight: From behind your frontline, apply poison with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma on Vladimir's path in or where he has already engaged, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he comes straight at you. If you're infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, step back and fight again after it ends, and don't group with allies and get hit together.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside Zed E Shadow Slash range to avoid the slow. If Zed uses Zed R Death Mark to engage, respond with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze or Cassiopeia W Miasma so he cannot deal more damage before the mark detonates. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so armor alone cannot stop it.
Zed.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive and prioritize armor. Zed’s main damage is physical, and Cassiopeia has low armor, so you need armor early to withstand his burst combo. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items.
Zed.fight: After landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the bonus movement speed to stay in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range while trading. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast misses, don’t walk forward to trade. Look for an opening after Zed W Living Shadow expires or after Zed has already switched places with his shadow.
Zed.laning: Poison minions with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to restore mana. Keep the wave in the middle if you have no reason to push, and save enough mana for Cassiopeia W Miasma when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Zed.combo: If Zed charges straight at you, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you placed Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast in his path beforehand, use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he charges over it, then follow with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Don’t cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang before he is poisoned.
Zed.escape: The moment after Zed W Living Shadow is used is an opportunity, but don’t immediately follow him in if Zed R Death Mark is still available, since he can use it to escape. In particular, catch him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Zed R Death Mark is unavailable.
Zed.phase: Zed is strongest in the mid game, so avoid getting caught alone then and stay grouped with your team. Zed falls off in the late game, while Cassiopeia deals high sustained damage as long as she isn’t caught.
Zed.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma in Zed’s path into your backline or beneath him after he dives in. Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when Zed or other enemies charge straight at you.

Yone.watch: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s knock-up is ready, you can be hit by both the knock-up and the dash, so wait out its stacks from outside its range. After Yone approaches with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can follow up with Yone R Fate Sealed, so don’t use Cassiopeia W Miasma or Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze too early.
Yone.build: Build mana items first so you can deal sustained damage. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so consider armor and magic resistance together instead of building only one type of resistance. If the enemy team has an assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items.
Yone.fight: After landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the increased movement speed to keep your distance and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. If Yone engages with a charged Q, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath him, and look for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when he charges at you facing forward.
Yone.laning: Keep the wave in the middle, poison minions with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then last-hit with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang to manage your mana. Don’t use Q to push the entire wave when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Yone.combo: If Yone engages straight at you, stun him with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, place Cassiopeia W Miasma beneath him for a chance to prevent him from moving and returning. Cassiopeia E Twin Fang’s bonus damage and healing apply to poisoned targets, so poison him first.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is on cooldown. He can also escape with Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed, so look for an opening especially when Yone R Fate Sealed is unavailable. Catch him then with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, poison him, and follow with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang.
Yone.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once she has mana items and has invested skill points in Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. In the late game, keep your distance so you don’t get caught and build up damage in team fights.
Yone.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Cassiopeia W Miasma in Yone’s path or beneath him, and use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when several enemies charge straight at you. Don’t line up with your allies and get hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave together, and don’t stand alone in the back where you could be the last target of Yone R Fate Sealed.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep shortly after and be easy to hit with Zoe Q Paddle Star! If the bubble hits, move behind a wall or an ally before you fall asleep to get out of Zoe’s attack range. A missed bubble remains as a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
Zoe.build: Managing mana is important for Cassiopeia early, so build a mana item first. Magic resistance, not armor, helps against the magic damage from Zoe P More Sparkles!, Zoe Q Paddle Star!, and Zoe W Spell Thief. However, Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces magic resistance and also deals true damage, so dodging the bubble takes priority even if you build resistance.
Zoe.fight: After landing Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, use the increased movement speed to stay within Cassiopeia E Twin Fang range while trading. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade. After Zoe R Portal Jump is used, attack the spot where Zoe returns.
Zoe.laning: Stand behind minions to deny Zoe P More Sparkles! empowered basic attack opportunities. If the enemy jungler’s position is unknown, don’t push the wave too far forward; keep it in the middle.
Zoe.combo: Your basic trade is to land Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, then repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Place Q at Zoe R Portal Jump’s starting point to poison her when she returns. When Zoe faces you and throws Zoe Q Paddle Star!, stun her with Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, then follow with Q and E.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses is your chance to approach.
Zoe.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once she has invested skill points in E and built a mana item. In the late game, deal damage from behind your team’s frontline so you don’t get caught.
Zoe.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Use Cassiopeia W Miasma in paths leading into your backline, and Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze when enemies charge straight at you. Before taking an objective, use a Control Ward to gain vision and watch for traps from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the distance, so don’t let him approach near minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits you twice, watch for the next Q knock-up and dodge sideways instead of only retreating. If you’re knocked up, Yasuo can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical and Cassiopeia has low armor, so prioritize armor. If the enemy team has an assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then commit to a trade. Aim Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where Yasuo will move, then use the movement speed it grants to keep your distance and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If Q misses, don’t walk forward to trade.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, keep a thin wave near your side so there are fewer minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use as stepping stones. Manage your mana by last-hitting with Cassiopeia E Twin Fang, and don’t push the lane forward when the enemy jungler’s position is unknown. Stay out of the straight line Yasuo Q Steel Tempest reaches and keep your distance.
Yasuo.combo: Use Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze in the path of Yasuo’s charge toward you, then place Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast where he is stunned and repeatedly cast Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. If you poisoned him with Q first, use R when he charges over it and follow with E. When Yasuo has his back turned, R only slows him, so don’t use it expecting a stun.
Yasuo.escape: Look to trade right after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is thrown, when its stacks reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t dive in just because he used it once. Engage when your team can chain crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again.
Yasuo.phase: Cassiopeia’s sustained damage becomes strong in the mid game once she has invested skill points in E and built a mana item. In the late game, she can deal high damage in team fights as long as she isn’t caught, so keep your distance.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, poison enemies with Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, and keep casting Cassiopeia E Twin Fang. Save Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze for when enemies charge straight at you.
